name: @activepieces/piece-plunk
description: Open-source email platform for transactional emails, marketing campaigns, and contact management.

auth.description:
Find both API keys in your Plunk project's API settings.

  - Secret API key (`sk_*`) is required for sending email and managing contacts.
  - Public API key (`pk_*`) is optional.It is only used by the Track Event action.

secretKey.description: Used for /v1/send, /v1/contacts, and the Custom API Call action.

publicKey.description: Required only for the Track Event action.

send_transactional_email.name: send_transactional_email
send_transactional_email.description: Send a transactional email through Plunk. Recipient can be a single address or a comma-separated list.

to.description: Recipient email address. For multiple recipients, separate with commas.

name.description: Optional sender name. Falls back to the project default.

from.description: Optional sender email. Must be a verified address on your Plunk project.

subscribed.description: When enabled, Plunk creates the recipient as a subscribed contact if they do not already exist.

aiMetadata.description: Sends a one-off transactional email through Plunk to one recipient or a comma-separated list of recipients, with an HTML body and optional sender name, from address (must be a verified Plunk address), and reply-to. Choose this for direct/triggered emails rather than marketing campaigns. Not idempotent: each call dispatches a new email, and enabling the subscribed flag will create the recipient as a subscribed contact if they do not already exist.

track_event.name: track_event
track_event.description: Track a Plunk event for a contact. Plunk auto-creates the contact if they do not exist. Requires the public API key.

event.description: Identifier of the event being tracked, e.g. `order.completed`.

email.description: Email address of the contact the event belongs to.

subscribed.description: When enabled, contacts auto-created by this event will be marked as subscribed.

data.description: Optional metadata stored alongside the event.

aiMetadata.description: Records a named event (e.g. order.completed) against a contact identified by email, optionally with arbitrary event metadata, to drive Plunk automations. Use it to signal that something happened for a contact. Requires the Plunk public API key in the connection, and auto-creates the contact if it does not exist. Not idempotent: each call appends another occurrence of the event.

get_all_contacts.name: get_all_contacts
get_all_contacts.description: Retrieve every contact in your Plunk project.

aiMetadata.description: Fetches the full list of contacts in the Plunk project, automatically paging through all results. Use it to enumerate or scan contacts when you do not already have a specific contact ID. Takes no input. Read-only and idempotent.

get_contact.name: get_contact
get_contact.description: Retrieve a single contact by ID.

aiMetadata.description: Looks up a single Plunk contact by its contact ID. Use it when you already have the exact contact ID; to discover IDs first, list contacts with Get All Contacts. Read-only and idempotent.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
